extras: Pro features require GitHub sponsorship ($5/month or $15 one-time).
problem: It addresses the difficulty in verifying that all source paragraphs from a Longform project are present and correctly matched in the final compiled manuscript.

relations.evidence: The plugin reads the scene order that Longform saves in the frontmatter of the index note.

summary: Compares scenes from a Longform project against a compiled manuscript note to identify source paragraphs that are missing or mismatched.
